verdict.rationale: Bitwarden has no built-in natural-language command interface. It does ship a first-party, verified MCP server (bitwarden/mcp-server on npm, handshake confirmed), which lets an AI assistant operate the vault from natural-language requests. The NL layer comes from the external AI client, and the evidence does not show which vault operations the MCP server exposes. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of the MCP server's tool coverage for vault operations, hands-on or independent evidence of NL-driven vault management working end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
